description: Maintenance knowledge of the rstobj library (Python objects that render reStructuredText through jinja2 templates): its architecture, the rendering and indentation rules, how templates are written, the case-driven snapshot tests and the docs Rendering Gallery they feed, and the compatibility policy with its known traps. Load it before changing any rstobj module, template, test case, or snapshot, or when deciding whether a change fits a patch release.
